sceneDescription: Mfinimfini no gyina hɔ ma saa browser yi Helia node. Mprempren wɔde node a ɛyɛ ahabammono a ɛhyerɛn abɔ browser no ho na ɛwɔ line bi a ɛkɔ mfinimfini. Wɔnam browser routing so huu violet nodes nanso ɛnyɛ nea ɛka bom. Gold nodes yɛ nkitahodi a wɔabue a mpɔtam hɔ Kubo daemon a ɛyɛ soronko no abɔ ho amanneɛ; wɔnyɛ browser nkitahodi na wonni line biara a ɛkɔ saa mfinimfini yi. Nsoromma a awu a wɔde slate ayɛ no kora abakɔsɛm a wɔatwa mu, na bere a wɔatwa nkitahodi no mu akyi nkutoo na woyi wɔn adanse nhama no fi hɔ. Ɔkwan a ɛda mfinimfini asase mfonini ahorow no susuw latency; atipɛnfo a wɔansusuw no gye akyi kyinhyia no, na akuwakuw a ɛyɛ anim akuw wɔ akwantu a wɔahu no mu. Nsoromma a wɔde asiesie akyi no nnyina hɔ mma atipɛnfo. Abɔnten so kyinhyia a ɛyɛ mmerɛw no hyɛ Kubo afuw a wɔde aba no agyirae na ɛnyɛ nkitahodi. Relay edge pue bere a relay ID no wɔ peer set a wɔahwɛ no mu nkutoo; wɔmfa atipɛnfo-to-atipɛnfo topology a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ no nsusuw ho da. Fa peer explorer no di dwuma ma nsɛm koro no ara wɔ nkyerɛwee kwan so.
